output.title: New opt-in ingress-shim flag; no use shown in environment
output.content: The change adds an ingress-shim option, `--extra-certificate-annotations`, which copies listed annotation keys from Ingress-like resources to the resulting Certificate. The release note describes it as a newly added option, so it only matters if someone sets it. The environment's values keys (e.g. replicaCount, webhook.timeoutSeconds, prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled) show no controller extra-args setting, and the manifests show a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate but no Ingress. The values dimension is only partial, so this is a note, not a firm conclusion.
